title: Industrial Engineering and Management Student
description: Job Details:       Job Description:   Job Description The Opportunity  Join Intel and help build the future of semiconductor manufacturing. Intel's Foundry Construction and Sourcing organization brings together the teams that source, plan, engineer, and build the facilities and infrastructure that enable semiconductor manufacturing in Kiryat Gat.    As a student, you'll work on real projects alongside professionals in construction, engineering, supply chain, sourcing and construction project management.  What You Will Do: Build and maintain Power BI reports. Collect, clean, and optimize data from Excel, SharePoint, and various systems. Building status tracks for projects. Create administrative KPIs and dashboards. Analysis of gaps, anomalies and treatment times. Automate reports and manual processes using Power Query / Power Automate. Building control and tracking tools. Improving work processes and documenting them. Support for performance analysis of suppliers/contractors/projects. Preparing analyses and presentations for making managerial decisions  What You'll Gain Hands-on experience in semiconductor manufacturing, construction, sourcing, and/or supply chain. Exposure to large-scale technical and business projects. Experience working with cross-functional teams, suppliers, and contractors. Opportunities to build analytical, technical, project-management, and communication skills. Mentorship and professional development from experienced professionals       Qualifications:    Minimum qualifications    BSc./MSc student in Industrial Engineering and Management, Information Systems or related relevant filed, with at least 4 semesters for graduate.  Availability for minimum 20 hours a week.  Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.  Ability to use data to identify anomalies and trends, and derive insights.  Advanced Excel skills including Pivot Tables, XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, formulas, and working with large tables.  Ability to build and develop key performance indicators (KPIs).  Process-oriented thinking and ability to identify improvement and automation opportunities.  Ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks.  Good communication skills and ability to work with multiple interfaces.  Good written and spoken English.  Technological curiosity and a desire to learn new tools.     Preferred Qualifications    Specializing in information systems, data analysis, or project management.  Experience with Power BI including building dashboards and reports.  Familiarity with Power Query, DAX, SharePoint or Power Automate.                     Job Type: Student / Intern     Shift: Shift 1 (Israel)     Primary Location:  Israel, Kiryat-Gat     Additional Locations:          Posting Statement: All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, religious creed, sex, national origin, ancestry, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, military and veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, gender, gender expression, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by local law, regulation, or ordinance.   Position of Trust N/A    Work Model for this Role  This role will require an on-site presence. * Job posting details (such as work model, location or time type) are subject to change.   *
